PLAN "12-week Upper Strength for Climber (Right Subacromial Impingement) + Recomposition Nutrition + Cardio + Climbing Prep - Phase3 Push Peak + Mobility + Saturday Finisher"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase upper-body strength with shoulder-friendly loading"
  GOAL secondary recomposition:
    name "Body recomposition: maintain lean mass while reducing fat"
  GOAL tertiary endurance:
    name "Build aerobic base for long climbing days"
  GOAL quaternary climbing:
    name "Peak upper-body and finger strength for week 12 climbing trip"
  GOAL quinary mobility:
    name "Improve shoulder and thoracic mobility to support pain-free climbing"
  GOAL senary fun:
    name "Saturday full-body finisher for variety and conditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (4 weeks)" (4 weeks):

      DAY Monday training 50m "Horizontal Push/Pull + Rotary Stability + Mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Aerobic Base Ride + Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x25 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
